name: Bindery
description: Bindery is a self-hosted book and audiobook manager in the *arr style. It tracks authors and series, searches Usenet and torrent indexers, hands grabs to your download client and imports finished files into your library, with OPDS, multi-user support and OIDC sign-in.

notes.text: Open the web UI once to create the admin account on the first-run setup page.
Books land in /books and downloads in /downloads. Mount your own storage on those paths or change them in /opt/bindery_data/.env.
